title: Transcript Settings Persistence
requirements: Persist TranscriptSettings (useOnDeviceSpeech, useWhisperFallback, and any toggles added) to UserDefaults using a dedicated prefix key (e.g. "transcription." + field) — reset to defaults absent
SettingsViewModel.transcriptionSettings initializer reads from UserDefaults, not TranscriptSettings(). Defaults match the prior struct initializer defaults
Add a save() / commit handler on SettingsViewModel that writes toggles to UserDefaults on change or on Save button (write-through optional but must be deterministic across SettingsView lifecycle)

Keep API-key persistence in Keychain (not UserDefaults) and ordering consistent: API key and settings survive restart together; Keychain + UserDefaults writes must not interleave inconsistently (no partial persistence)
Read settings on app launch before constructing TranscriptionService (so useOnDeviceSpeech/useWhisperFallback reflect persisted values)
acceptance_criteria: Toggle useOnDeviceSpeech or useWhisperFallback, restart the app, verify the toggle holds
A fresh installation with no UserDefaults sees default TranscriptSettings values
API key (Keychain) and settings (UserDefaults) persist independently and survive restart
